❓ Frequently asked questions

What counts as the cost of buying?

Down payment, ~2% closing costs, mortgage principal + interest, plus ~1.2%/yr for property tax, insurance and maintenance — minus the equity you build (appreciation + principal paid).

What is the breakeven year?

The first year the net cost of buying drops below the cumulative cost of renting. Before that year, renting is cheaper.

Why might renting win long term?

In expensive markets with low appreciation, rent growth below mortgage costs, or short stays, renting can stay cheaper for decades.
